budget.softLimitDisclosure: --max-budget-usd is estimated-spend software control, may overshoot and differ from invoiced spend.
budget.beforeNextCall: Parent-owned ledger settles all CLI/provider attempts and reserves unknown/in-flight exposure. Set each CLI invocation --max-budget-usd to min(case $2 - settled spend - unknown/inflight reserves - $0.25 headroom, remaining monthly envelope), never a fresh fixed $2 on every invocation. Require positive remaining allowance and reserve estimated full next call including thinking/caching/hidden continuations/classifier/subagents. If not sufficient, stop before dispatch.
budget.operatingHeadroom: Keep $0.25 of each $2 case budget for one in-flight request and unknown settlement. At $1.75 projected exposure pause before another call. Lower planned call token limits if the next-call reserve exceeds headroom.
budget.exhaustion: Stop and report BUDGET_BLOCKED/INCOMPLETE, never weaken the oracle, substitute a cheaper unqualified model, or label partial execution PASS.
budget.retry: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=0 by default; explicit approved retries are separate ledger attempts and never erase failed attempts.
budget.allocation: Preparation review is separate from the 39 case reservations. Check actual month-to-date balance before starting the 39 Clouds; $200 credit application is not assumed.
budget.monthlyBalanceGate: knownMonthlySpendUsd=null blocks paid product dispatch until parent records month-to-date paid/unknown exposure and sufficient unreserved balance. Preparation review spends are separately included in the monthly ledger.
budget.separateJevLedger: Case ledger records JEV exposure, but any historical JEV-specific $5 cap remains independently enforced including prior JEV usage. Do not merge, replace, or erase that limit with hostAPI monthly approval.
budget.cliLimitObservation: Preparation review: one CLI invocation requested --max-turns 1/output 4500 and reported num_turns=3/output_tokens=11603. These limits must not be treated as an exact total HTTP-call/output cap. Record all reported turns/cache use; actual wire call count is unknown unless independently observed.

preparationReview.limitation: CLI succeeded but final result contained only the last JSON segment; original beginning is unavailable. Recovered concrete findings were reviewed and corrected by the preparation owner. No additional reviewer/model call was made.

earlierAuthenticationEvidence.scope: Synthetic API/CLI authentication checks; not AGS product host PASS. No credentials, requests, response bodies or session addresses included.

knownEstimateLimitation: Sum of retained estimates only, not month-to-date total or invoice. Review estimate remains historically preserved; unknown exposure remains separately reserved.
